MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The heat shrink tubing fits my battery holders, relay modules, and PCB supplies because it helps insulate the wire connections those projects involve.",
    "Recommending a wiring supply recognized that I may need supporting materials to finish the electronics projects I have bought components for."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Printer filament assumes I own and use a 3D printer; buying breadboards and electronic components does not establish that need.",
    "Cutting wheels and a feeler gauge serve specific tasks I have not shown a need for, while glue and epoxy would require a particular repair to interest me.",
    "The large glue packs exceed my occasional repair needs, and the locking nuts require size compatibility I cannot establish from my past purchases."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My hands-on purchases seem to have been treated as interest in almost any workshop supply, even when it serves a different task.",
    "Buying component assortments seems to have been taken as a reason to offer bulk supplies, although I choose quantities based on what a project needs."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The connection between battery holders, breadboards, PCB supplies, and relays matters because they support related wiring and prototyping tasks.",
    "My purchases are spread out over time, so they do not necessarily indicate an active project or an immediate need to replenish supplies.",
    "I need a clear use and compatible specifications before choosing specialized tools, hardware, or consumables."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my hands-on interests but stretched them beyond electronics supplies with a clear use in my projects."
}
